justificativa: The candidate draws the stamp text centered on the stamp origin, which sits near the margin's lower-left corner. Prawn clips a stamp's content to a BBox of [0, 0, page width, page height], so the half of the phrase that falls at negative coordinates is cut off. Only then does `stamp_at` move it to the page center, so the result is a partial, truncated watermark; it also lacks the official fix's paper-based band, edge margin and shrink-to-fit.
